about_the_game:
Clockwork Rabbit - relaxing puzzle game with level editor and time manipulation

Clockwork Rabbit is a single-player, relaxing, isometric view puzzle game set in a steampunk world inhabited by.... adorable bunnies! Meet Tessa - a young mechanic working in a textile factory in Clockwork Town, where each room hides different puzzles and new mechanics.
The game combines time manipulation, action planning, programming of auxiliary robots and creative approach to puzzles. No time limits - it's all about ingenuity and enjoyment of gameplay here. Perfect for quiet evenings.

Independent art production

Hand-drawn graphics inspired by Alfons Mucha posters and Art Deco and Art Nouveau styles make each level a small work of art.
Atmospheric theater music provides deep focus and full immersion into the game world.

A charming and narrative puzzle game

Discover the rich narrative and stories of the residents - moving, surprising, and sometimes.... too human for rabbits.

Create your own levels - full map editor!

Clockwork Rabbit offers a level editor so you can create your own puzzles and share them with the gaming community. Add obstacles, program sequences, play with logic and creativity. This is a game that doesn't end after the credits.

Who is this game for?

🤔 For fans of stress-free puzzle games
🕰️ For players who love time manipulation
⚙️ For creators who are looking for a game with a level editor
🎨 For those who like a charming graphic style, female protagonists and a calm narrative
🇵🇱 For those who appreciate Polish independent games and a unique atmosphere

Key features:

  • A cozy and enjoyable game
  • Single-player adventure with a storyline background
  • Isometric view
  • Time manipulation
  • No violence, no ads, no micropayments
  • Stylized graphics and unique atmosphere
  • Full level editor
Start your rabbit adventure today! 🕰️🥕
Catch the rabbit! 🐰

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+)
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support (anything after 2010 will work)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 6000
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Not obligatory
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3 or AMD Ryzen 3 (any models of those)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 980M
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Obligatory

short_description: Solve cozy time manipulation puzzles and unravel a charming story about rabbit mechanics.
